state.text: We brought new drawings to the treehouse, and messages to Joren. There were still maps we hadn't finished. We made room for both.

astraviin.title: Astraviin
astraviin.description: The people who live within and share a close bond with an Astravus. Cali and her community are Astraviin.

astravus.title: Astravus
astravus.description: A great living ship that travels through the cosmos and is home to a community. In Sage's story, Aria, Bram, and Cora live aboard one.

constellation.title: Constellation
constellation.description: A committed romantic partnership among adults. Cali's five parents form a constellation; the family they raise together also includes their children and animal companions.

familiar.title: Familiar
familiar.description: An animal companion who shares a family's daily life and is treated as a member of the family. Shadow, Barkley, and Nibble are Cali's household familiars.

first_breath.title: First Breath
first_breath.description: A child's birth and welcome into the community. Cali's parents remember her First Breath at the Sanctuary.

lumen.title: Lumen
lumen.description: Cali's home: a young, living Astravus, the child of Aurora and Nyx. Its gardens, paths, and gathering places are part of the world its residents share.

sanctuary.title: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: The place where children are born and welcomed by their waiting parents. Cali's parents brought her home from the Sanctuary.

transcendence.title: Transcendence
transcendence.description: Joining with one's Astravus. In Cali's world, this is the familiar course of life, distinct from death.

tree_of_echoes.title: Tree of Echoes
tree_of_echoes.description: An ancient, hollow tree brought here when Lumen was founded. It grew from a seed given by an ancient Astravus, a reminder of the community's heritage.
